04 — About

A developer who finishes what he starts

I am a software engineer who likes practical software — tools that save people time, not demos that only look good in a screenshot.

My degree at Abbottabad University of Science and Technology (AUST) was taught entirely in English and grounded in the subjects I still use daily: data structures & algorithms, software construction, databases and computer networks. My final-year project, UB_MULTI Tools, received full marks in both parts.

Alongside my studies I worked as an IT & Database Systems Operator at DHQ Pharmacy, Bajaur (Jul–Sep 2024) — real operational work with real data, where accuracy mattered every single day. That mix of building software and running live systems is what I bring to a team.

06 — Process

How I work

A simple, honest process — the same one behind every finished project above.

01

Understand

First I understand the real problem — who will use the tool, what they do today, and where the time actually goes.

02

Design

Then I design the workflow and the data before writing code, so the structure is right from the start.

03

Build

I build in small, working pieces — testing as I go, keeping the interface simple and the code readable.

04

Deliver & Refine

Finally I deliver a finished, working tool — then refine it based on how it performs in real use.
